Subject: FinFabric — SOC2/SIG evidence: SSO/SCIM/RBAC

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 scoping for FinFabric and need a handful of access-control artifacts from Redwood to complete the SIG questionnaire and evidence pack. Our external audit window opens next month, so if possible we'd like the artifacts within three business days. Below is the precise list we need: 

- SAML assertion samples (redact any PII; include NameID formats, attributes sent, and example assertion timestamps)
- SCIM provisioning logs: delta and full provisioning events covering the last 30 days (include event type, user id, timestamp, and status)
- RBAC role mapping and a least-privilege matrix showing role → permissions for admin/engineering/support/service-accounts
- Confirmation of SSO config: issuer, ACS URL, signing algorithm (screenshots acceptable)
- Retention policy for provisioning and auth logs (how long do you keep logs by default; can you supply a signed statement?)

If you can provide a zip with redacted examples plus a short readme describing how the artifacts were generated, that would be ideal. We can accept S3/Drive links or a secure SFTP drop.

Two quick clarifications: 1) We need SCIM deltas (not just snapshots) if possible; 2) We may request a small Q&A call after reviewing.

Thanks — please confirm owners and ETA.

Best,
Jane Doe

Hi Jane / team — looping in with technical details and a couple options for the SCIM data.

What we'll produce in the bundle (ETA EOD Thu):
- scim-delta-sample.csv: a 30-day sample containing add/update/deactivate events. All PII (email, display_name) will be hashed or redacted per your request. Each row will include: event_id, timestamp (UTC), change_type, target_id, status.
- saml-assertions-samples.txt: 3 example assertions (one interactive web login, one service-account exchange, one SSO re-auth) with all sensitive attributes masked and an explanatory header for each sample.
- rbac-least-privilege-matrix.xlsx: role → permission mapping for standard roles; we will include a short narrative of default privileges for new accounts and a note on service-accounts.

Retention and logs: by default we retain provisioning and auth logs for 90 days in hot storage; 365 days archived. We can provide a signed statement of retention policy if your auditor needs it — would you like that in PDF?

SCIM scope question: do you need full provisioning history for the 30-day window (every event), or a representative delta log (sampling every Nth event + all failures)? Full history will be larger but straightforward; sampling reduces size and still demonstrates behavior.

Security notes: tokens and session identifiers will be redacted. We will also include the assertion cert fingerprint but not the private key.

I'll prepare the CSV/TSV and the RBAC matrix and upload to a secure Drive with expiration. Deliverables will be listed in a short readme.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
